== Description ==

[[Brian Fred]] (right, bald, glasses, goatee, white Colts sleeveless jersey, shaking hands), [[Patrick Johnson]] (left, short dark hair, grey graphic tee, smiling, shaking hands), and [[Chris Wirfs]] (standing mid, navy floral/Hawaiian button shirt, khaki shorts) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
